title: 再一抽就保底了
mood: frantic, triumphant and a little broke
subject: a college student ninety pulls into a gacha banner at midnight in her dorm, three roommates leaning out of their bed curtains to watch
caption: Chinese ACG anime-rock in the fast story-song style of Chinese anime and mobile-game theme songs, sung by a human singer. Double-tracked overdriven guitars on fast power chords; sixteenth-note piano arpeggios running under every verse; a busy, slap-inflected electric bass; driving eighth-note drums with a crash on every bar downbeat, stop-and-hit unison breaks, a half-time pre-chorus and a key change up a whole step into the last chorus. Bright, compressed and dense, the guitars wide, the piano and the voice forward. Female voice, bright and high in an anime-idol timbre, very fast syllable runs with tight pitch, spoken character lines for the roommates, and a small group shouting the countdown answers. 176 BPM, B minor. Frantic, triumphant and a little broke. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no ballad section, no dizi or erhu, no robotic synthesized voice, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, guitar riff and piano arpeggio, crash on every bar]

[Verse 1]
半夜十二點零一分 新卡池開了
宿舍四張床 三顆頭從床簾裡探出來
這個月的飯錢 全部換成了鑽石
十連抽 十連抽 再來一個十連抽
藍的 藍的 藍的 紫的 又是藍的

[Pre-Chorus - half-time]
小美說 妳冷靜一點
阿婷說 妳明天吃什麼
我說別吵 計數器上寫著八十九

[Chorus]
再一抽就保底了
我把手機舉到窗邊 拜一拜月亮
再一抽就保底了
三個室友一起倒數 (三 二 一!)

[Verse 2]
金光一閃 整間宿舍都亮了
歪了 出來一個常駐的 我早就有了
小美笑到從上舖滾下來 阿婷在錄影
我盯著屏幕 一句話都說不出來

[Break - stop-and-hit unison band hits]
等一下 等一下
原來這只是 小保底

[Chorus - key change up a whole step]
再九十抽就保底了
我把下個月的飯錢 也拿出來算
再九十抽就保底了
三個室友 一人借我一百 (一百!)

[Outro - guitars ring out, spoken]
泡麵我請
抽到了 換我請妳們吃火鍋
